description:
A dynamic pricing section with animated cards, confetti effects, and monthly/yearly toggle.

Features:
	•	Animated pricing cards using Framer Motion
	•	Interactive monthly/yearly pricing toggle with a confetti effect
	•	Responsive design using a mobile-first approach
	•	Dynamic price updates with NumberFlow animations
	•	Industry-specific content customization
	•	Popular plan highlighting
	•	Dark mode compatibility
